candidates: testsuite/integration-arquillian/tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/testsuite/organization/cache/OrganizationCacheTest.java:381 - Cleanup removes the literal alias "alias" instead of the IDPs the test creates.. `testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove` binds to an IDP named `"alias"`, which does not exist. None of the `idp-alias-*` providers created here are removed after the test. They stay in the shared test realm and can break later tests that count or list IDPs, or that call `getForLogin`. The same mistake is on line 425. Fix: capture the real alias, e.g. `String alias = "idp-alias-" + i; getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get(alias)::remove);`, and do the same for `idp-alias-20`.
